job_name: Understand terminology and definitions
job_statement: When I encounter unfamiliar terminology, I want to access a comprehensive glossary, so I can clearly understand the specific container and platform concepts being discussed.
module_note: reference: architecture glossary
job_notes: Partial. The job asks for a single comprehensive glossary, and one exists -- welcome/glossary.adoc, 86 terms -- but it is an unmodularized assembly: the definitions are inline definition lists with no include::modules/ lines, so there is no module to map and nothing for a job map to include. What is modularized instead is a set of per-feature-area glossaries (architecture, install, nodes, storage, authentication, monitoring, registry, updates, disconnected, API compatibility), which together cover most but not all of welcome/glossary.adoc. Missing: either modularize welcome/glossary.adoc, or accept the per-area glossaries as the job's content and reconcile the terms that appear only in the unmodularized assembly.
